name: Can drain locating help with recurring clogs?

mainEntity.name: Can drain locating help with recurring clogs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, drain locating is highly effective in addressing recurring clogs. When clogs frequently reoccur, it often indicates a deeper issue than just a simple blockage, such as a collapsed pipe, a significant belly (sagging section), or severe root intrusion. By precisely locating the drain line and often using a camera inspection simultaneously, technicians can identify the exact nature and location of the underlying problem. This allows for targeted repair or replacement, solving the root cause of the recurring clogs rather than just providing a temporary fix.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, drain locating helps with recurring clogs by pinpointing the exact location and nature of underlying issues like collapsed pipes, bellies, or root intrusion.
